what: Multiplicity axis, run 2 — after the generator was repaired
supersedes: grammar_multiplicity_run1.json, which is preserved: run 1's numbers were correct but two of its axes were non-evidential
generator_repairs: sheetset_members: the case now addresses header, fields and exclusions against the PROTOTYPE MEMBER and classifies every other sheet. Fixing the generator does not mean enabling sheetsets -- it means producing a VALID representation of an UNSUPPORTED construct, so the INTENDED refusal is what fires. Run 1 refused with column_unclassified / unresolvable_referent / sheet_unclassified as well: the right outcome for the wrong reasons, and therefore no evidence about the axis.
period_measures: each declaration now binds a DISTINCT source column. Binding the same range twice added column_double_bound to the refusal, contaminating it the same way.
why_the_breakdown_matters: '24 cases, 0 findings' is less useful than the breakdown. A correct refusal is evidence for the REFUSAL BOUNDARY; it is not evidence about the semantics behind that boundary. Reporting one number would conflate the two.

claims_by_axis.measures: 0..3 all executed, m0..m2 each present -- multiplicity honoured in full
claims_by_axis.derived: 0..3 all executed, d0..d2 each present -- multiplicity honoured in full
claims_by_axis.exclusions: 0..3 all executed; absent-label exclusions correctly no-ops
claims_by_axis.ignored_sheets: 0..3 all executed; ignored material does not affect the output
claims_by_axis.period_measures: 0..1 executed. 2..3 deterministically REFUSED. The claim is NOT 'multiple period measures are handled correctly' -- it is 'multiplicity greater than one is OUTSIDE THE EXECUTABLE LANGUAGE and is deterministically refused'. That is cleaner: a deliberately small language is not a weakness when the boundary is explicit.
claims_by_axis.sheetset_members: 1..3 deterministically REFUSED for the intended reason only. Same claim shape: sheetsets are outside the executable language, and the refusal is now shown to be the intended one rather than an accident of a malformed case.

canary_reachability: A canary is valid only if the deliberately defective behaviour is demonstrated to have REACHED the invariant's observation point. Now enforced: each canary reports fired AND reached, and an unreachable stimulus is reported distinctly from a detector that failed to fire. Demonstrated by deliberately blocking a stimulus at validation and observing CANARY UNREACHABLE.
next_axes_not_opened: value domains, with No Undeclared Interpretation
